item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Training margins are large, but they measure separation from supplied negatives rather than difficult recommendation choices. Seek diagnostics that expose failures against plausible alternatives, stratified by training-history frequency and title/description similarity. Keep these diagnostic candidate panels separate from the unchanged host evaluator; unobserved items are not confirmed dislikes, and diagnostic ranks are not benchmark HR@10.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation easy negative saturation hard negatives sampled versus full catalog ranking popularity stratification 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Final-event deletion dominates the observed effects, but also changes the readout event. Seek practical instrumentation of the actual HSTU network—gate activations, residual-path contributions, and matched activation interventions—to distinguish final-item dependence from useful prefix processing. Require identity controls and intervention checks; attention weights alone cannot establish explanation faithfulness. Use the existing fitted model without auxiliary predictors.","query":"sequential recommender mechanistic interpretability gated attention residual stream activation patching attribution faithfulness last item shortcut HSTU 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"User feedback distinguishes specific usefulness, redundancy, compatibility mismatch, and insufficient evidence. Seek an evidence-grounded recommendation audit using only available titles, descriptions, histories, timestamps, and explicitly supplied feedback. Require supporting text spans, an unknown outcome for missing specifications, and manual calibration on the twenty-user sample. Track uncertainty separately from rejection; purchases do not prove ownership or fulfilled needs, and missing metadata does not prove incompatibility.","query":"recommendation diagnostic rubric grounded user feedback complement substitute redundancy compatibility specifications selective prediction insufficient evidence human annotation calibration 2024 2025 2026"}]}
